name: Jiten Topiwala
headline: Robotics Engineer & Innovator
tagline: *Physical AI*, built to survive the real world.
short_bio: Robotics Engineer with a Mechanical Engineering degree, combining hardware expertise with software intelligence to create machines that matter.
long_bio: I'm a Robotics Engineer with a Mechanical Engineering degree, blending mechanical design, robotics software (ROS2, Nav2, perception), and embedded firmware. I've taken autonomous ground robots from concept to field deployment — including founding-engineer work in agricultural robotics — alongside award-winning competition robots, industrial inspection systems, and surveillance robots (with a patent in process), plus published research in IEEE and IJIRT. I enjoy turning research into real-world, deployable systems, and I'm available for freelance and consulting work.
